shortDefinition: AI tools and platforms that enable building workflows and applications without programming.
fullDefinition: No-code AI refers to tools and platforms that allow non-developers to build, deploy, and use AI-powered applications through graphical interfaces rather than code. Examples include Zapier (automation), Bubble (app building), Notion AI (workspace AI), and Copilot Studio (Microsoft agents). The no-code movement has dramatically expanded who can build useful AI-powered systems.
